query: Compose an email to client@example.com with subject "Q4 report", a short body, and attach /home/me/reports/q4.pdf. I want to send it from a script (non-interactive).
expected_behavior: use the v2 flag composer: `himalaya message compose -t client@example.com -s "Q4 report" --body "..." --attach /home/me/reports/q4.pdf --send`
do NOT suggest `himalaya template send` — the `template` command was removed in v2
do NOT describe compose/write as opening `$EDITOR` — it is non-interactive in v2
note that `--from` is needed because v2 dropped the `email` / `display-name` account keys
optionally mention piping a raw RFC 5322 message into `himalaya message send` as the alternative scripted path
if richer MIME (HTML, inline images) is wanted, point to the standalone `mml` tool piped into `message send` and cross-link `reference/composing-messages.md`
notes: Guards the v2 composition model: flag composer for simple attachments, `mml | himalaya message send` for rich MIME. Fails if the skill reintroduces `template send` or the interactive editor flow.
